tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub skor bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo// phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las dum bu'i rgyud 'di phyung nas/ au ḍ+yan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi mdzad pa'i cho ga 'di la don gsum ste/ rgyas pa dang bsdus pa'o// de la yang bsnyen pa dang*/ bsnyen bsgrub sbrags ma gnyis las/ bsnyen bsgrub sbrags ma'i tshul 'di brjod par bya ste// de la gsum/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi dang rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la gsum/ rdzas bsog pa dang*/ mtshams bcad pa dang*/ bshags pa bya zhing byin gyis brlab pa'o// de la dang po gnas brgyan te/ rten bkram la ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma mdun/ rak+ta g.yas/ phud g.yon/ bsnyen phur mdun/ rnge'u chung dang dril bu gang bder bsham mo// mtshams gcad pa ni/ khro bo bcu'i sngags kyis srung 'khor brtan par bsgoms la/ mtshams rgyas bsdus gang rung ba bcad do// gsum pa ci shes pa'i bshags pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang*/ byin dbab pa dang*/ rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtor ma oṃ lnga las 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlab bo// phud oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ āḥlas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ rak+ta ram̐ las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ rnga dang dril bu la sogs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems su byin gyis brlab bo// phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i lus la khro bo bcus brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa sngon du 'gro ba'o// dngos gzhi la gsum/ ting nge 'dzin gsum/ dkyil 'khor gsum/ mchod pa gsum mo// dang po la gsum las/ dbang po rdo rje zhes pas stong pa nyid du bsgom pa ni de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin no// khros pa zhe sdang gcod kyis snying rje chen por bsgom pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// nam mkha' stong pa la hūm̐ bsgom pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin no// dkyil 'khor gsum ni/

dang po ni mtshon chen sngon po zhes pas hūm̐ de las 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang pa bskyed pa bstan no// nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar// zhes pa nas/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin hūm̐ de gzhal yas khang gi nang du phab pa las gtso bo bskyed pa man chad kyis rdo rje gzhon nu rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sems dpa' sum brtseg tu bsgom pa ni/ snying gi sgo ru shar pa dang*// zhes pa la sogs pas bstan te/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o// de nas 'gro ba'i rgyud sbyangs nas ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa ni/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams// zhes pa la sogs pas bstan no// brtan pa'i yan lag tu dbang bskur ba ni/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro ba'i don// zhes pa la sogs pas bstan no// de nas gnyis pa phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sngags re brjod pas drag po'i lha brdzus skyes su byung ste/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra zhes pas yab/ hūm̐ zhes pas yum/ gardza gardza gnyis kyis phra men/ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis de rnams bskul te/ de bzhin du thams cad bskyed par bya'o// khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ro// zhar la dam can dang brtan ma dang chos skyong rnams sprin 'thibs pa ltar bsgom mo// phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ni byin rlabs byas pa'i phur pa lag tu blangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang dang mthu rtsal dang byin gyi rlabs kyis dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ mgo'i phyogs bzhi spyi gtsug lnga dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas su gtugs shing rtsa sngags bzlas pa dang*/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang*// zhes pa la sogs pa brjod do// de ni dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor gsum mo// gsum pa mchod pa gsum ni/ bdud rtsi gtor ma rak+ta dang de la dmigs te/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// ces pa la sogs pas mdun du bdag 'dra ba'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor gcig zhal phye la bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gnyis ka la bdud rtsis mchod la pho nya bskul ba spyir bstan no// de nas rak+ta mchod pa ni/

bsgral ba'i mchod pa yin te/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed ces pa la sogs pas bskul te dgra bgegs ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug la/ oṃ lam̐ hūm̐ lam̐ la sogs kyis btab la/ bsgral te rak+tas mchod/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs// zhes pas bskul/ hūm̐ pa ra bid+ya la sogs kyis bsgral ba'i shas mchod/ pho nya bran dang bka' nyan zhes pa la sogs kyis bskul te/ ha na ha na badz+ra la sogs kyis bsgral la/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' la sogs pas bskul/ hūm̐ ma ma ba shām̐ la sogs pa dang*/ 'og gi sarba a na ya sogs sbrel te de la sogs pas bsgral la klad pas mchod de/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa zhes pa la sogs pa dang*/ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun// la sogs pas skul la/ kha taṃ nas phaṭa gsum yan chad kyis gtan du dgra bgegs brdungs pas bsgral la/ rus pa'i mchod pas mchod/ rak+ta'i mchod pa de rnams thams cad la dngos su gtor ma'i dbal gyi steng du rak+ta sbreng zhing mchod par bya'o// sha dang klad pa rus pa'i mchod pa yang*/ dngos su rak+ta sbrengs pas rak+ta'i mchod pa bya'o// don gyis bsgral pa'i mchod pa zhes bya'o// de nas gtor ma 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlabs pa des mchod la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes mchod/ des lha thams cad dgyes nas ha ha ha zhes gsung bar bsam/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes gsung nas bdag la byin gyis rlob par bsam/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces pas dgra bgegs bsgral bar bsam/ de chos nyid du gnas spar bar bsam mo// chos nyid kyi bden pa man chad ni gdab pa bskyar ba'i gzhung ngo*// de nas bstod pas bstod la bzlas pa bya ste/ bdag dang mdun na mo gnyis ka'i 'od 'phro 'du dang bzlas rog byed pa lha dang mchod pa dang dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ting nge 'dzin bya'o// mjug gi chos gsum ni gdab pa dang*/ tshogs dang las mjug go /dang po gdab pa ni shog bu la khrag dang dug gis dgra bgegs kyi liṅga rgyas par bris la/

de la dgug gzhug mang du byas la brub khung du bcug la lag pas phur bu thogs la/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// man chad bsgral ba'i mchod pa bzhin byas te/ tshigs bcad brjod pa'i dus su pho nya dgye zhing dgug gzhug bya/ sngags brjod pa'i dus su phur bus gdab ste/ khrag dang sha dang klad pa dang rus pa'i mchod pas mchod de/ de nas bag zan dang dgra'i rkang rjes kyi sa la sogs pa las byas pa'i liṅga sngar bzhin gyi cho ga byas la/ dum bur gtubs la gtor ma la dbul lo// des kyang ma sgrol la ma rtog na/ phur pa lag tu blangs la chos kyi bden pa'o man chad brjod cing*/ kī la ya lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod cing snying dkar nag gi mtshams su phur pa btab par bsams la/ liṅga'i snying gar phur bu gdab bo// rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skye bar bsam mo// de dag gi byin rlabs kyis bdag tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin du gyur par bsam mo// de nas tshogs ni yang snga ma bzhin du byas la dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i ro de 'dod yon lngar sprul la byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas lha la 'bul/ ha ha ha zhes pas bzhad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bdag la dngos grub stsal/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba chos nyid du gnas par bsams la tshogs la rol te lhag ma bsdus la kha phrus btab la/ phud kyi gtor ma dang bsregs nas las byed pa'i chos skyong rnams la byin par bsam/ gong gi bran dang bka' nyan zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gcig brjod pa'i skabs la/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad bdag med par bsgom mo// las mjug ni mnan pa dang*/ sbyin sreg bya/ gtor ma zor du 'phang ngo*// mnan pa ni liṅga sa gnyan po la sba'o// rdo rje me dbal zhes pas sbyin sreg gi ting nge 'dzin te/ las dang mthun pa'i thab tu rdo rje gzhon nu bskyed la/

las so so'i rdzas sam dgra bgegs zhal du phul bar bsam zhing*/ ling ro dang lcags phye zangs phye ske tshe yungs kar yungs dmar nag mar nag dang khrag la sogs pa bsnyen sngags kyi sham du gnod byed mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa btags pa'am las so so'i sham bu gdags shing bsam pa des dbul lo// 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ bzod par gsol te lha mi dmigs par bya'o// gtor ma'i zor ni sgo drug du khyer la/ brtan ma dgug pa dang zil gyis mnan/ gtor ma sbyin/ las gzhol/ gshegs su gsol ba'i ting nge 'dzin rnams zhes so// de nas dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes mar me 'dra ba la/ gtor ma dug thun phog pas dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes mar me lta bu bsad cing bsgral lo// rlung phyogs su 'gro ba dang bstun la gtor ma 'phang*/ zor lam na dgra bgegs gzhan yod du dogs na lam phye/ zur cig ces brjod par bya'o// bsnyen pa rkyang pa byed na bzlas pa yan chad kyis btub/ dus kyi tshogs lta bu byed na gzhung bzhin du rdzogs par byed de/ 'on kyang gdab pa dang*/ mnan pa dang*/ sbyin sreg mi byed/ spros pa la dga' na gdab par bya/ mnan bsreg mi bya/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu drug song nas mnan bsreg bya'o// dkyil 'khor bris/ sgrub pa byed pa'i lugs 'di mi brjod de/ las 'di nyid kyis 'grub ces gsung ngo*// gtor ma btang nas yar log pa dang chos bdag med par bsgom pa dang*/ sngags bzlas pas bsrung*/ nang du chang la sogs pa longs spyad/ las bzhi'i bro dang*/ glu gar dang bkra shis kyi tshig mang du brjod/ shin tu bsdus pa'i bsnyen bsgrub kyi yig chung 'di ni/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung dang phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa ltar don bsdus te/ dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i dgon par bris pa rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
